top_signals.title: Global AI Trade Under Pressure, Oil Extends Rally: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: The artificial intelligence trade stayed on the back foot as investors rotated out of one of the year’s hottest themes and sought safety in bonds. Adding to the pressure, crude oil extended its gains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
